system.description:
You bring your hands together, interlocking your fingers until your hands resemble a single bludgeoning device. Make a melee taijutsu attack dealing your [Unarmed damage] + 1d12 bludgeoning damage and the target must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save they gain +1 rank of Concussed.

Finisher: You instead deal your [Unarmed damage] + 3d12, and increase the ranks of concussed inflicted by +1 on a failed save.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d12.
